name: Partick Thistle: One Team in Glasgow
original_name: Partick Thistle: One Team in Glasgow
overview: In Glasgow, football isn't just a game—it's a religion. And for 150 years, one small club has offered sanctuary to those seeking an alternative faith. After seven years in Scotland's second tier, the 2024/25 season promised to be different for Partick Thistle. With a boosted budget and renewed ambition, Thistle were finally favourites to win promotion back to the Premiership. The club opened their doors to a film crew expecting to document a long-awaited title triumph. Through unprecedented access to players, management, and the fans and volunteers who are the club's lifeblood, this series explores the beautiful futility of supporting the underdog
